answer_1.quote: we propose a new integrated task, stance-specific summarization, which is suggested by the experiment results to improve summarization on argumentative dialogues

answer_2.quote: We choose the well-established ROUGE  scores as automatic evaluation metrics and report standard F 1 scores of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: we also conduct a human evaluation on generated summaries. The evaluators were requested to rate the generated summaries by four aspects: conciseness, fluency, faithfulness and informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluators were requested to rate the generated summaries by four aspects: conciseness, fluency, faithfulness and informativeness. An overall average is calculated.
